Messages.Author: Grey Wanderer
Messages.Body:
1. Nedal, the Careless cannot replace combat cards played until my next
untap phase. So, this overrules the disciplineless cards like Lucky
Blow and Fake Out, which aren't replaced until after combat?

2. I may use four transfers and burn 1 pool to give Aimee Laroux an
additional level of Melpominee. Is this a permanent effect; she has mel
for the rest of the game? If so, through this method, I can get her to
MEL?

3. I can't use Pack Alpha to recruit a Laibon-only animal retainer like
the Elephant Guardian if my vampire isn't Laibon, can I?

Eric Tomas
Quezon City, Philippines

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 6 Dec 2005 17:36:08 -0800, "Grey Wanderer" <gre...@gmail.com>
wrote:

>1. Nedal, the Careless cannot replace combat cards played until my next
>untap phase. So, this overrules the disciplineless cards like Lucky
>Blow and Fake Out, which aren't replaced until after combat?

Yes.

Nedal's do not replace clause over-rides the do not replace clause on
Lucky Blow and Fake Out.

See the parallel with Visit from the Capuchin and Gehenna Events.

LSJ Jun 8 2004

Yes and Yes.

>3. I can't use Pack Alpha to recruit a Laibon-only animal retainer like
>the Elephant Guardian if my vampire isn't Laibon, can I?

Correct.
You cannot get around requirements with Pack Alpha, the vampire
employing the retainer must meet all of the requirements.
